instruction: I want to control VLC playback using a global keyboard shortcut even when the window is not in focus. How can I configure VLC to enable the global play/pause hotkey?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's global play/pause hotkey. Uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric function to verify the VLC config file has global-key-play-pause set (expected_global_key_play_pause=1 means the setting is configured, 0 means it's empty/disabled). This allows controlling VLC even when the window doesn't have focus. No custom functions needed - reuses existing VLC evaluators.
